title: Recording annotations v1
description: GET /api/v1/recordings/{recordingId}/annotations (staff) and its ?download=1 file: the review document of one recording's accepted job. Each part is the published stage artifact (segments.v1, captions.v1, hand-presence.v1) or the http.dag-run.v1 rendering, embedded unchanged, so the parts keep their own casing (snake_case artifacts, camelCase dag_run). A part is null only when its stage produced nothing; dag_run says why. The recording_annotations rule checks that every present part names the same job and recording and that every caption row names a segment row.
